title: Ogre Menace
description: Three travelers on the southern road haven't reached Elder Moor since midsummer, and the last body found on the verge outside Hollow's Bend had marks too big to be a man's. Garrison Captain Yorick Dane won't send soldiers after one beast when there's a whole road system to hold, hence the coin - for whoever wants it more than the garrison can spare the men.

objectives.description: Kill the ogre working the southern road out of Hollow's Bend

notes: Threat: three travelers dead or missing on the southern road out of Hollow's Bend. Giver motive: Captain Dane can't pull soldiers off the wider road network for one beast, so he pays instead. Refusal: the southern road stays closed to ordinary traffic and the toll of missing travelers keeps rising.
